verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev has a documented management API, so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec: the probe found 404s at every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path. The llms.txt file and the MCP server are adjacent AI-facing features, not an API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
